definitions.explanation: The process of becoming old, worn out, and deteriorated over time, especially referring to buildings, infrastructure, or equipment.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}が{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}している。
examples.english: The building is deteriorating with age.

examples.japanese: {老朽化|ろうきゅうか}したインフラの{更新|こうしん}が{急務|きゅうむ}だ。
examples.english: Updating the aging infrastructure is urgent.

examples.japanese: {設備|せつび}の{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}による{事故|じこ}。
examples.english: An accident caused by deteriorating equipment.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{建物|たてもの}の{老朽化|ろうきゅうか} - building deterioration
・{設備|せつび}の{老朽化|ろうきゅうか} - equipment aging
・インフラの{老朽化|ろうきゅうか} - infrastructure deterioration
・{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}した{橋|はし} - an aging bridge
・{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}{対策|たいさく} - measures against deterioration

USAGE NOTES:
Primarily used for physical structures and equipment, not for people (though {老化|ろうか} can be used for biological aging).

RELATED WORDS:
・{劣化|れっか} - deterioration, degradation (more general)
・{老化|ろうか} - aging (biological)
